scope.accepted_use: Exact bounded T7 source-truth, chronology, source-class, negative-fixture, mapping, local-provenance, and blocked/non-runnable browser-disposition evidence only.

chronology_and_authority.boundary: Git proves immutable publication chronology. Current owner authority ratifies exact commits now; it does not prove or invent original historical approval messages.

conditional_consumption: Preserve all eleven explicit unknowns and all current-versus-historical source-class boundaries.
Do not use historical implementation, cancelled design, catalog prose, specification prose, analogy, or browser failure records to establish missing current behavior.

Do not claim successful route reachability, gameplay, trusted input, compact/wide responsive behavior, completion, persistence, XP, idempotency, API correctness, production behavior, or asset loading from the five browser dispositions.
Disclose that provider-side provenance was unavailable and that the acceptance uses local Git and SHA-256 compensating controls.
Disclose that owner approval is a current retroactive ratification and that no original message identifier is authenticated.
Do not treat this evidence acceptance as an ontology, shared-system, implementation, or shipping decision.
revocation_rules: Any byte change or digest mismatch in the bound audit, approvals, candidates, reconciliation, batch manifests, truth tests, reviews, predecessors, or source evidence revokes consumption.
Any source-class promotion, hidden unknown, browser-success overclaim, invented provenance, unresolved Critical/High/Medium finding, or use outside the five-game T7 scope revokes consumption.
Remediation must be additive and must bind the exact superseded digest; historical lifecycle files must not be rewritten.

publication_binding.rule: The publication commit is the first Git commit containing these exact bytes; a post-commit Git note may record the resulting commit SHA without mutating this manifest.
